claims: The Assistants API was deprecated on 2025-08-26 and is scheduled to be removed on 2026-08-26.
The recommended replacement for the Assistants API is the Responses API and Conversations API.
Reusable prompt objects were deprecated on 2026-06-03, and the v1/prompts API is scheduled to shut down on 2026-11-30.
Reusable prompt content should move into application code.
